purpose: Test unchanged RC39 original classical active learner+W-method on independent external TLS protocol machine graphs and a DOT syntax different from MQTT, after RC41 external MQTT first PASS. No re-training, no change to learner policy, no ARC task consumption.
scope: Separate externally authored legacy TLS Mealy models, public and researcher-opened before prereg, not blind to experiment author. This is external protocol family portability within the SAME Mealy formalism, not general Q6 cross-formalism semantics and not autonomous neural invention.
source_rights: Learner receives source membership(input_string)->output_string, external fixed alphabet and trusted model upper bound only; full reference table passed only to resettable output backend and independent after-freeze checker.
protocol_conversion: Different published DOT format uses numeric state nodes, first standalone numeric state denotes start, no semicolon on transitions, labels 'input/output'. Generic strict adapter encodes sorted input/output labels into single ASCII characters, without changing original frozen learner or W-method.
primary_gate: 2/2 exact independent all-length equivalent, 2/2 altered emission output negative rejected, 2 unique frozen external DOT blob SHA, strict source parser rejects malformed/incomplete/incorrect-state-count input; preserve ORIGINAL FIRST even if FAIL.
degraded_mode: If source model incompatible/too large, model state limit, query budget, wrong hash, inconsistent output or otherwise invalid, report FAIL or UNKNOWN and do not claim proof. A FALSE trusted bound can produce incorrect certificate and is not discoverable by finite samples alone.
